data.exact_reserve_text:
Reserve deteriorations on prior year losses (defined as movements on closed years of account and on previous accident years' catastrophe losses) contributed 7.8% (2023: 3.7%) to the net claims ratio and included an increase in provisions held for potential exposures arising from the Russian invasion of Ukraine within the Aviation and Marine & Energy divisions.

Within the calendar year technical result, a deficit of GBP 100,715,000 (2023: deficit of GBP 41,496,000) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 166.464m in 2024 (an increase in gross claims outstanding compared to the opening position), representing a 7.69% adverse movement versus opening gross reserves. This deterioration was driven by adverse prior-year development and increases in provisions related to geopolitical exposures (notably arising from the Russian invasion of Ukraine) within the Aviation and Marine & Energy portfolios, together with catastrophe and large-loss developments (e.g. Hurricanes Helene and Milton). Offsetting factors in some divisions included favourable prior-year reserve releases relating to prior catastrophe losses (eg Hurricanes Otis, Ian and Idalia) primarily in Property & Motor.
raw_causal_phrases: Reserve deteriorations on prior year losses (defined as movements on closed years of account and on previous accident years' catastrophe losses) contributed 7.8% (2023: 3.7%) to the net claims ratio and included an increase in provisions held for potential exposures arising from the Russian invasion of Ukraine within the Aviation and Marine & Energy divisions.
Within the calendar year technical result, a deficit of GBP 100,715,000 (2023: deficit of GBP 41,496,000) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

The closed years of account were impacted by an increase in provisions for potential exposures arising from the Russian invasion of Ukraine within the Marine Excess of Loss class, in addition to adverse developments across the Energy account.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding) comparative prior year explicit. Prior-year development (gross) taken from Technical Provisions reconciliation: 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' = 166,464 (GBP '000) => 166.464m. Exact prior-year narrative also reports a net prior-year deficit of GBP 100.715m (net of reinsurance) - that net figure is cited in the report; the gross figure used here is the authoritative 'Insurance liabilities' column from the technical provisions table. Named events mentioned in the report are not quantified individually. Claims development triangle is present (gross) and was used to cross-check but the movement note is used as primary. No explicit per-LOB quantified prior-year movements were provided; LOB directions are inferred from narrative.
